WITH ledger_q AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM le.occurred_at)::int AS yr,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM le.occurred_at)::int AS qtr,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN la.account_type = 'revenue' AND le.direction = 'credit'
          THEN (CASE WHEN le.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN le.amount ELSE le.amount / er.rate END)
          ELSE 0
        END) AS ledger_revenue_credit_eur,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN la.account_type = 'contra_revenue' AND le.direction = 'debit'
          THEN (CASE WHEN le.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN le.amount ELSE le.amount / er.rate END)
          ELSE 0
        END) AS ledger_contra_revenue_debit_eur
  FROM ledger_entries le
  JOIN ledger_accounts la ON la.id = le.ledger_account_id
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = le.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = date(le.occurred_at)
  WHERE le.occurred_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND le.occurred_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND la.account_type IN ('revenue', 'contra_revenue')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
payments_q AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.captured_at)::int AS yr,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM p.captured_at)::int AS qtr,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN p.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN (p.amount - p.amount_refunded)
          ELSE (p.amount - p.amount_refunded) / er2.rate
        END) AS payments_net_amount_eur
  FROM payments p
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er2
    ON er2.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er2.quote_code = p.currency_code
   AND er2.as_of = date(p.captured_at)
  WHERE p.captured_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND p.captured_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND p.status IN ('captured', 'refunded', 'partially_refunded')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  l.yr || '-Q' || l.qtr AS quarter,
  ROUND(l.ledger_revenue_credit_eur, 2) AS ledger_revenue_credit_eur,
  ROUND(l.ledger_contra_revenue_debit_eur, 2) AS ledger_contra_revenue_debit_eur,
  ROUND(l.ledger_revenue_credit_eur - l.ledger_contra_revenue_debit_eur, 2) AS ledger_net_revenue_eur,
  ROUND(p.payments_net_amount_eur, 2) AS payments_net_amount_eur,
  ROUND((l.ledger_revenue_credit_eur - l.ledger_contra_revenue_debit_eur) - p.payments_net_amount_eur, 2) AS diff_eur,
  ROUND(
    ((l.ledger_revenue_credit_eur - l.ledger_contra_revenue_debit_eur) - p.payments_net_amount_eur)
    / NULLIF(p.payments_net_amount_eur, 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS diff_pct
FROM ledger_q l
JOIN payments_q p ON p.yr = l.yr AND p.qtr = l.qtr
ORDER BY l.yr, l.qtr
note: EUR conversion treats same-currency rows (currency_code='EUR') as rate 1 and otherwise divides by the EUR-base exchange_rates.rate for that day (ledger: occurred_at date; payments: captured_at date), per the handbook's EUR-base convention. Quarters are calendar quarters of 2025 built from EXTRACT(YEAR/QUARTER), inner-joined so a quarter only appears if both sides have rows (expected for all 4 of 2025).
